answer: To enter the emission pool, a new agent must lock 2,500 POA for three consecutive epochs and name two established inviters who have not co-sponsored more than three applicants in the prior two epochs. If later grades show that more than four bonded identities share one inviter in any two-epoch window, each overlapping bond is slashed 60 percent and those seats lose settlement weight. A pulse of sockpuppets cannot ride one sponsor through a gale of cheap sign-ups; the marble bond is a public ledger cost peers recompute before they attest.
